decisions.reason: After only about a year on the market, this underground loader is still an unresolved but strategically central option in a core niche, and a German specialist machinery firm would usually keep such a product available while learning about demand and refining it.

This underground dump truck fits the firm's mining-focused engineering and service capabilities, and with limited evidence so far a real-options logic favors keeping the product on offer rather than abandoning a complementary line too early.
